title: Evaluating Spatial Understanding of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the shortest path distance on the spatial grid between the model's incorrectly predicted object location and the ground truth location to determine if errors systematically cluster at topologically close nodes.

Measuring the temporal distance (the number of objects) between the first occurrence of the ground truth item in the prompt and the predicted item to evaluate if the model has an inclination to predict objects located in the textual vicinity of the ground truth.
